prompt.generated_prompt_string: Using the attached illustration as a visual reference, create the real-person photography version: a three-quarter vertical editorial portrait of an adult woman with long wavy auburn hair, a gentle downward gaze, pearl necklace and earrings, wearing an ivory off-shoulder knit sweater dress with a secure neckline and relaxed sleeves. She is seated naturally on the edge of a bed, with one hand lightly adjusting the knit fabric at her shoulder. Preserve the source image's auburn hair, ivory knit silhouette, pearl accessories, warm beige bedroom wall, framed artwork, bedside lamp, and white bedding, while translating the anime rendering into natural realistic photography. Use late-afternoon window light at approximately 4200K plus a warm practical bedside lamp for soft side-lit hair highlights and realistic room shadows. Nikon Z8, 50mm f/2, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, lifted blacks, visible knit texture, and natural skin texture.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, childlike appearance, sexual pose, exaggerated body proportions, anime rendering, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: The attached source illustration is required and defines the character's auburn hair, ivory knit outfit, pearl accessories, pose, and bedroom environment. Translate only its visual design into an adult real-person photograph; do not use it to reproduce a real person's identity. A separate approved-adult face reference is optional and, if attached, must preserve that person's facial structure and likeness.

assets.name: source anime illustration
assets.usage: Translate the depicted character design, outfit, pose, accessories, and bedroom composition into realistic photography.

assets.name: approved adult face reference
assets.usage: When supplied, preserve this adult person's face, facial structure, and likeness in the live-action result.

changes: Specified an adult subject and removed body-focused conversion ambiguity.
